summary: User Waypoints & Places Backend API testing completed. All 30 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend sync indicator working correctly. Fixed route ordering bug for bulk delete endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Bulk delete routes were defined after single delete routes causing route conflict - moved bulk delete routes before single delete routes in user_waypoints.py
Backend API properly serializes MongoDB ObjectId to string (no _id serialization issues)
Input validation working correctly (422 for missing name, invalid lat/lng)
Sync endpoint prevents duplicates based on name + coordinates proximity
updated_files: /app/backend/user_waypoints.py - Fixed route ordering for bulk delete endpoints
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during pytest run
context_for_next_testing_agent: User Waypoints & Places API fully tested. All CRUD operations working: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE for waypoints and places. Sync endpoint working with duplicate prevention. Stats endpoint returns correct counts. Bulk delete endpoints fixed and working. Frontend sync indicator (Wifi/Cloud icons) visible in header. Frontend successfully creates waypoints via backend API.

api_waypoints_get.notes: Returns list of waypoints, supports active_only filter

api_waypoints_post.notes: Creates waypoint with validation, returns created object with id

api_places_get.notes: Returns list of places, supports type filter

api_places_post.notes: Creates place with all fields (address, phone, website, rating)

api_sync.notes: Syncs local data to backend, prevents duplicates

api_stats.notes: Returns waypoints count (total/active/inactive) and places count by type

api_bulk_delete_waypoints.notes: Deletes all waypoints for user (FIXED: route ordering)

api_bulk_delete_places.notes: Deletes all places for user (FIXED: route ordering)

api_validation.notes: Returns 422 for missing name, invalid lat (>90), invalid lng (>180)

frontend_sync_indicator.notes: Wifi icon + Cloud icon + 'Sync' text visible in header

frontend_backend_integration.notes: Waypoint created via UI was saved to MongoDB backend, toast shows 'Waypoint créé et synchronisé'

bug_fixed.root_cause: FastAPI route ordering - /waypoints/{user_id}/bulk was being matched by /waypoints/{user_id}/{waypoint_id} where waypoint_id='bulk'
bug_fixed.fix: Moved bulk delete route definitions before single delete routes in user_waypoints.py
